transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Jessica. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Jessica. I'm calling because I want to set up automatic payments from my bank account. I think I get a discount for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, absolutely! We do offer a discount for setting up direct debit. I can certainly help you with that. First, for security, could I get your full name and the Customer ID from your bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure. My name is Thomas Young. The customer ID is... let me find it... okay, it's CUST-1013.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Young. I've located your account. To fully verify it, could you please provide the 4-digit security PIN you set up with us?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the PIN is 6692.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's correct. Thank you for verifying your information. So, you'd like to set up direct debit from a checking account for the autopay discount. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's the one. I'm currently paying with my credit card, but I saw on the website that the $10 discount is only for using a bank account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are absolutely correct. The $10 monthly discount applies specifically to payments made via ACH transfer from a checking or savings account. I can get that set up for you right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. What information do you need from me?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll need your bank's name, the 9-digit routing number, and your bank account number. Do you have that information handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I do. I have my checkbook right here. The bank is Capital Trust Bank.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Capital Trust Bank. Got it. And whenever you're ready, please provide the 9-digit routing number.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, the routing number is 0 5 1 0 0 0 0 1 7.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me repeat that back to ensure accuracy. That's zero-five-one-zero-zero-zero-zero-one-seven.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. And now the account number, please.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The account number is 8 4 4 6 2 1 9 9 0 3.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, let me read that back as well. That's eight-four-four-six-two-one-nine-nine-zero-three.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Just so you are aware, by providing this information, you are authorizing Cymbal Telecom to debit this account for the total amount due on your monthly bill. This authorization will remain in effect until you notify us to cancel it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. And if I need to change it, I just call back?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can call us, or you can also manage your payment methods online through your MyCymbal account portal. It's quite easy to update there as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Good to know. Alright, I consent to that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Young. I am now entering the information into our secure billing system. This will just take a moment. Please stay on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience. The system is just validating the account details with the bank. Should be just another 30 seconds or so.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, take your time. Better to get it right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, Mr. Young, thank you for holding. I have great news. The banking information has been validated and successfully added to your account as the primary autopay method.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent! So, the discount will be applied now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. I have also enrolled you in the $10 direct debit discount program. Now, your current bill has already been generated for this month, so the first automatic withdrawal and the discount will apply starting with your next billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ah, okay. So I still need to pay this month's bill manually?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the exact status of your current invoice... one moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see your latest bill was generated three days ago, and it's due on the 25th of this month. Since the autopay setup needs one full billing cycle to take effect, that payment will not be withdrawn automatically. You would need to make that payment as you normally would.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I can do that online with my card like I usually do. So when will the first automatic payment happen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your next bill will be generated around the 5th of next month. The automatic withdrawal will then occur on the 25th of next month, and it will reflect the discounted price.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So my plan is $85 a month. That means next month's bill will be for $75?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly right. Your Fiber Gigabit Broadband plan is $85, and with the $10 autopay discount, your new monthly total will be $75 plus any applicable taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the money will come out of my checking account on the 25th of every month, starting next month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. The payment date is always the 25th. You will receive your e-bill via email about 20 days prior, so you'll always know the exact amount before it's withdrawn.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's perfect. That's exactly what I wanted. So the credit card I had on file is removed now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new bank account is now set as the default autopay method. Your credit card is still on file but is no longer marked for automatic payments. Would you like me to remove it completely from the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Maybe leave it for now. Just in case I ever need to make a one-time payment for something else. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. It can remain on your account as a secondary, manual payment option without any issue. It will not be charged automatically.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. This is much easier than I thought it would be.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try to make it as simple as possible. I'm also sending a confirmation email to the address we have on file, thomas.young@telecom-personal.com. Is that still the best email for you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email. A confirmation would be great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You should receive it within the next 15 minutes. It will just summarize that your payment method was updated to direct debit and that you've been enrolled in the discount program.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. What happens if, for some reason, a payment doesn't go through? Like if I forget to have enough money in the account on that day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. If an ACH payment fails due to insufficient funds, our system will automatically notify you via email and text message. We would then attempt the withdrawal one more time three business days later.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so there's a bit of a grace period.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, and it's important to note that your bank may charge you an insufficient funds fee. If the second attempt also fails, autopay would be suspended for that month, and a late fee could be applied to your account. You would then need to make a manual payment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And would I lose the discount?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the autopay fails, the discount for that month would be reversed on your next bill. But as long as the payment is successful the following month, the discount would apply again.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's very clear. Thank you for explaining all the details. I'll be sure to mark my calendar for the 25th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome. It's always good to be informed. I've added a note to your account documenting our conversation today, confirming the setup of direct debit and the explanation of the billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I appreciate that. It's good service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We do our best. Saving $120 a year is always a nice bonus for our customers.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It really is. That's almost two free months of internet when you think about it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great way to look at it! I'm glad I could get this all sorted out for you today, Mr. Young.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Me too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we end the call, was there anything else at all I could assist you with? Any questions about your Cymbal Wi-Fi, your plan, or anything else?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, the internet service has been great, no complaints there. Just wanted to get the payment sorted. That was everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so happy to hear that your service is working well for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yep, it's been solid.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, in that case, thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Jessica. You've been very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure, Mr. Young. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful day!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
